title: Learning from Natural Images Untangles Number Sense
abstract: arXiv:2611.33615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Numerical cognition is a simple yet fundamental ability that remains challenging for modern vision-language models. Meanwhile, number sense is already present in numerically na\"ive animals, suggesting that it can emerge without explicit numerical learning. Deep neural networks provide a related observation, with numerosity-selective units appearing after training on unrelated natural-image tasks and even before any training. However, these findings leave unresolved whether visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity. Human development provides a clue, as children become better at making judgments in which numerosity and proportion conflict. Here, we introduce a geometric framework to trace how representations of these two quantities change across learning. translated_title: 从自然图像中学习解缠数感
translated_abstract: 数值认知是一种简单却基础的能力，但对现代视觉-语言模型而言仍然具有挑战性。与此同时，数感已经存在于从未接受过数字训练的动物中，这表明它可以在没有显式数字学习的情况下自发产生。深度神经网络提供了一个相关的观察：在训练于不相关的自然图像任务之后，甚至在任何训练之前，就会出现数量选择性单元。然而，这些发现仍未解决视觉学习在数量选择性的自发产生之外是否还有额外贡献的问题。人类发育提供了一个线索：儿童在数量与比例相互冲突的判断中会变得越来越好。在此，我们引入一个几何框架来追踪这两种量的表征在学习过程中如何变化。尽管未训练网络和预训练网络在单元级数量选择性以及基本比较能力上表现相似，自然图像……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个几何框架，发现尽管未训练与预训练网络的单元级数量选择性相似，但自然图像学习能将数量与比例的表征解缠分离，证明视觉学习在数量选择性的自发产生之外仍有重要贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a geometric framework showing that, although untrained and pretrained networks exhibit similar unit-level numerosity selectivity, learning from natural images untangles representations of numerosity and proportion, demonstrating that visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity.
